About this Event

🎟️ Bollywood Glitz: Black & Gold Edition (Hartford, CT)

Hartford, prepare for a night of pure luxury, heavy bass, and unmatched energy. 

On Friday, December 11th, AV Entertainment and Hartford Bollywood are joining forces to bring you the ultimate premium nightlife experience: Bollywood Glitz.

We are stripping away the ordinary and stepping into a world of high-end glamour. This is where sophisticated style meets the raw, driving energy of a festival main stage, fully energized by the sharpest Desi beats in the country.

🎧 Behind The Decks: DJ Dharak

Stepping up to the decks to headline the night is the unstoppable DJ Dharak. Known for devastating dance floors across the nation with flawless mixing and explosive energy, Dharak is set to deliver a massive, high-speed sonic journey.

Expect a premier curation of heavy Punjabi bass, high-tempo Bollywood festival edits, tech-house grooves, and exclusive anthems that will keep the room vibrating until the lights come up. Backed by a state-of-the-art sound system, immersive laser arrays, and custom visual projections, this is a full-sensory club experience designed for true night owls.

✨ The Vision & Vibe
The Dress Code: Strictly Black & Gold. Dress to impress. Think sleek black fits, metallic gold accents, sharp blazers, and premium streetwear. Step up your style game and come camera-ready—the media team will be capturing everything under the strobe lights. Not mandatory tho:)The Sonic Profile: Heavy curation of global Desi music, Punjabi club bangers, tech-house grooves, and high-energy Bollywood remixes.The Environment: A perfect collision of high-end luxury and festival-grade club production. Think tinsel-lit accents, custom fog machines masking the bass drops, and a high-octane community vibe where everyone is there to dance.🗓️ Event Logistics & Details
